notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
[i][b]Game Mechanics: [/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Hay bales letters can now be guessed (and Mia will suggest words which include hay bales)
[*]An extra life! Players now start each level with 3 hearts, not 2
[/list]

[b][i]Quality of Life: [/i][/b]
[list]
[*]Keys and joysticks now auto repeat movement
[*]The definition button now always activates, not just on definitions that are too long for the box 
[*]Additional feedback for incorrect word
[*]Will no longer suggest words that include a metal tile as these were impossible to collect
[*]Mia will try not to suggest the same word more than once
[*]Updated definitions
[/list]

[i][b]Bug Fixes: [/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Fixed hay bales appearing in earlier levels before tutorial text given
[*]Fixed red tiles appearing in earlier levels before tutorial text given
[*]Fixed an issue where scores on tiles were incorrect
[*]Fixed an issue with the hints on early levels not showing correctly
[/list]
